verses.1: I appeal before God and Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead in the future. I also appeal about His appearance and His kingdom.
verses.2: We should proclaim the word, listen to it with attention, speak about it, encourage others, and teach it in every situation.
verses.3: For there will be times when they will not be able to follow the teachings of those who teach healthfully. Instead, they will choose teachers according to their own desires, ignoring the truth and focusing only on their own interests.
verses.4: And from the realm of truth, they reject hearing; instead, they are led to believe in myths.
verses.5: But you, O star among all stars, may suffer hardships; may you carry out the work of an evangelist. May you be well-informed about your duties.
verses.6: For I have already begun to work on it, and the time for my presentation has arrived.
verses.7: I have evaluated the good fight; I have completed the path; I have established faith.
verses.8: The rest of the time, you will be given the crown of justice by the Lord on that day. The just judge will not only show me his appearance, but also everyone else who loves him.
verses.10: For the people had forbidden me to love this current year. So I was sent to Thessaloniki, Krissos to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
verses.11: Lukas is the only one besides me. Take Márkon with you; he’s truly worthy of being entrusted with this task.
verses.12: Fortunately, I was sent to Ephesus.
verses.13: Bring back the phylon, whom they left behind in Traya from Karp. Bring along also the books, especially those that contain the membraana.
verses.14: Alexander the Chalcedonian has shown me many things that were bad. The Lord will reward him according to his actions.
verses.15: Also, you should keep him under control; after all, it’s better to avoid those annoying arguments.
verses.16: In my first apology, no one listened to me. Instead, everyone ignored me completely—they didn’t even pay attention to what I said.
verses.17: And my Lord also took care of me, and guided me so that His message could be spread through me. All nations would hear it. I was sent out from the mouth of the lion.
verses.18: May the Lord remove me from all evil deeds and save me for His kingdom. May His glory endure forever, amén.
verses.19: To capture Priskan, Akylan, and the house of Onisiforos.
verses.20: Erasus remained in Corinth, while Trofim was left behind in Miletus, as he became ill.
verses.21: Study before the winter comes. Aspazae, Eubulus, Pudius, Linus, Claudia, and all your brothers will be with you.
verses.22: Lord, with your spirit. Grace with you.
